dedupe_keys.name: verisk model exchange vendor neutral platform for third party catastrophe models

description: Verisk Model Exchange is a cloud platform from Verisk's Catastrophe and Risk Solutions business that hosts more than 400 third-party peril models from over 20 providers, so that insurers can run and compare several independent views of catastrophe risk in one governed environment. Users can also develop their own in-house models and compare them side by side with vendor models to study uncertainty and tail risk. Beyond natural catastrophes, the platform now offers several independent cyber threat models. Coverage: perils, regions and asset classes of the hosted models; the model and vendor list was not read. Format and access: browser-based, cloud-native software with an end-to-end API workflow, batch runs and exposure validation; it uses the Oasis Loss Modelling Framework open data standards, Open Exposure Data (OED) for inputs and Open Results Data (ORD) for outputs; a self-guided demo is offered, and access is through sales. Licence: proprietary; terms and prices were not read. Caveats: the register listed this page under Nasdaq risk modelling; ownership history was not read on the page. Model documentation from the hosted vendors was not read. Simulation uses: running multiple hazard and loss models on the same exposure to compare risk to buildings and infrastructure portfolios. Related records: Verisk's own models (model-verisk-catastrophe-risk-models-touchstone), the Oasis LMF (platform-oasis-lmf) and the OED standard (data-oasis-open-exposure-data-standard).
